title: task.sh giveup --json preview (contract 1)
description: What a give-up would drop, printed by 'task.sh giveup <ID> --json' without --yes; nothing changes. Consumers ignore keys they do not know. See core/contract/contract.md, «Preview».

root.description: Id of the task given up.

falls.description: Every task that would fall, the root first, as a tree in pre-order: each child followed by its own subtree. Its length is the number of tasks that fall.

abandoned_phases.description: Phase folders that would become abandoned and were not, in phase order.

status.description: Status of the task now. Only ready and draft tasks can fall; any other refuses the give-up.

phase.description: Phase folder of the task, phase-<n>-<slug>.

parent.description: Id of the task that brought this one into the walk; null on the root.

depth.description: 0 on the root, the parent's depth + 1 on the others.

also_depends_on.description: Other live blockers of the task, in header order: tasks of the plan that do not fall and are not done, cancelled or abandoned. [] on the root.
